en: This is a vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a wide view of a seashore with mountains in the background. There are a few small white buildings near the shoreline. The foreground shows a calm sea with some rocks sticking out. The bottom part of the postcard contains printed text in Greek and French, and handwritten script overlays part of that area. There is a prominent watermark (www.elia.org.gr).
